NONE: › If a bed is unmade, its sheets and covers are still untidy from having been slept in.
（床鋪）未整理的
› to destroy a reputation or a career
破壞（名譽或事業）

example: Actors' reputations have been made and unmade on this London stage.
就在倫敦的這個舞臺上，一些演員一戰成名，另一些卻名譽掃地。

NONE: › impossible to deal with or manage
無法對付的；無法處理的

example: 74 percent of teachers said their paperwork was unmanageable.
74%的老師表示文書工作多到他們無法應付。
Long, curly, unmanageable hair needs a good conditioner.
又長又卷、沒法梳理的頭髮需要使用高品質的護髮素。

NONE: › used to refer to a spacecraft, or a place where military guards work, that has no people present to operate or be in charge of it
（太空船或崗哨）無人的

example: an unmanned mission to the planet Mars
對火星的無人探測飛行

NONE: › having no signs or marks showing what something is
無標誌的，無記號的

example: an unmarked police car
一輛無標誌的警車
She died penniless and was buried in an unmarked grave.
她死的時候身無分文，被埋在一處無名墳墓裡。

NONE: C1 not married
未婚的，單身的

example: an unmarried mother
未婚媽媽
Their youngest son remained unmarried.
他們的小兒子還是單身。

NONE: › to show the bad, and previously hidden, truth about someone or something
使暴露；揭露

example: At the end of the play the villain is unmasked.
反角的身份在劇終時曝光了。

NONE: › having no equal; better than any other of the same type
無可匹敵的，無雙的，無與倫比的

example: For years they have enjoyed a standard of living unmatched by any other country in Europe.
多年來，他們所享受的生活水準是歐洲其他任何國家都無法比擬的。

NONE: › shocking or embarrassing, and therefore not allowed or disapproved of as a subject of conversation
不宜提及的；難以啓齒的

example: the unmentionable possibility that we might lose the war
我們可能戰敗這一難以啟齒的可能性

NONE: › underwear
內衣
› not satisfied, or achieved
不滿意的；未實現的

example: These children have many unmet needs.
這些孩子有許多未滿足的要求。
The demand for affordable housing is largely unmet.
提供負擔得起的住房這一要求在很大程度上沒有滿足。

NONE: › not remembering, noticing, or being careful about something
對…不留意；對…漫不經心
› An unmissable film, play, etc. is so good that it must be seen
（電影、戲劇等）不能錯過的
› not likely to be confused with something else
不會弄錯的，確定無疑的

example: There was an unmistakable smell of incense in the air.
空氣中有明顯的薰香味道。

NONE: › complete, often describing something bad or unsuccessful that has no good or positive points
（常指壞事或不成功的事）完全的，徹底的，十足的

example: The whole venture has been an unmitigated disaster.
整個經營專案徹底失敗了。

NONE: › not feeling any emotion
不爲所動的，無動於衷的，冷漠的

example: Both men appeared unmoved as the judge read out their sentence.
在法官宣讀判決時，兩個人都表情麻木。
